title: Two-DOF modal superposition under a step force
source: Chopra, Dynamics of Structures, 5th ed., §9.4; modal superposition of independent undamped SDOF step responses.

quantities.quantity: mode-superposed displacement of DOF 1 at t=0.5 s
quantities.reason: Each uncoupled modal coordinate has the closed-form step response (1-cos(omega t))/omega^2; the retained basis contains both modes exactly and the fixed-step error bound is 2e-6.

quantities.quantity: mode-superposed displacement of DOF 2 at t=0.5 s
quantities.reason: The second modal coordinate has omega=2 rad/s and the same closed-form step response; both modes are retained.

quantities.quantity: mode-superposed displacement of DOF 1 at t=1 s
quantities.reason: Each uncoupled modal coordinate has the closed-form step response (1-cos(omega t))/omega^2; the retained basis contains both modes exactly and the fixed-step error bound is 2e-6.

quantities.quantity: mode-superposed displacement of DOF 2 at t=1 s
